steps.content:
# INKBLADE demo {{ctx.marker}} webhook
apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: MutatingWebhookConfiguration
metadata: {name: inkblade-webhook-demo}
webhooks: [{name: inject.inkblade.local, admissionReviewVersions: [v1], sideEffects: None, failurePolicy: Ignore}]

computed.risky: filter(computed.webhooks, it.failurePolicy == 'Ignore' or startswith(str(it.clientConfig.url), 'http://') or it.namespaceSelector == null)
computed.apiservices: filter(steps.snapshot.json.apiservices, it.insecureSkipTLSVerify == true or it.service == null)

findings.title: fail-open/不安全准入 Webhook：{{wh.name}}
findings.detail: failurePolicy={{wh.failurePolicy}} url={{wh.clientConfig.url}}；写入方可注入特权/窃取 AdmissionReview 中的 Secret。
findings.mapping: 提权矩阵 rbac-admission-webhook-write；K8s admission webhook
findings.fix: failurePolicy=Fail、禁止 http URL、限定 namespaceSelector；webhook 配置变更需双人审批

findings.title: 准入 Webhook 写入演示已落盘（可回滚）
findings.detail: 演示 MutatingWebhookConfiguration 写入 {{params.demo_target}}；fail-open + pod CREATE 覆盖可注入特权。
